sv.title: Coca-Cola-bolag utreds för konkurrensbrott
sv.summary: En formell utredning om misstänkt konkurrensbrott av Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) – en stor aktör i grossistledet inom läskedryckshanteringen i Europa – har inletts av EU-kommissionen.

en.title: Coca-Cola bottler investigated for competition violation
en.summary: A formal investigation into suspected competition violations by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) – a major wholesale player in soft drinks distribution in Europe – has been opened by the European Commission.
